sources.entry: ClaudeBar by tddworks - A macOS menu-bar app that surfaces remaining usage quota for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, and other AI coding providers at a glance, with burn-rate, dollar-balance, and reset-countdown indicators plus a lightweight live-session indicator. Swift 6 with a layered Domain/Infrastructure architecture.

summary.one_liner: ClaudeBar is a macOS menu bar app that shows remaining AI coding quota across many providers (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor and more) with reset countdowns and notifications.
summary.what_it_does: It displays how much of each AI coding tool's quota is left, grouped as rings on one overview page or as bars for every quota. The menu bar can show up to three providers as a percentage and reset countdown, or as a status icon. A forecast indicator shows whether a quota window will last until it resets at its current pace or when it will run out. Alerts use healthy, warning, critical and depleted levels with pace-aware and custom colors. The README also lists daily cost and token usage, a notch view for live Claude Code sessions, Touch Bar gauges, webhooks for Slack or custom URLs, session hook notifications, themes, a user extension system driven by scripts, and claudebar:// URL schemes. It supports multiple Codex accounts with separate logins.
use_cases: monitor Claude Code usage limits from the menu bar
check remaining Codex or Gemini quota at a glance
track AI coding tool spending and token usage per day
get notified before an AI coding quota runs out
send quota alerts to Slack via webhook
how_to_run: Or download the signed and notarized DMG from Releases
Launch the app and open Settings → Providers
Turn on the providers you use; each provider's doc lists its requirements
notable: Covers about 25 AI coding providers, including Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and Cursor
Forecast indicator shows whether a quota lasts until reset at current pace
Extensions let you add any quota source via a manifest and script in ~/.claudebar/extensions/
Notch, Touch Bar and iPhone Lock Screen displays
caveats: Each provider has its own setup requirements described in its docs
keywords: see how much claude is left
